content_sections.heading: AUD Job Description
content_sections.text: The project requires self-motivated candidates with strong communication and coordination skills to support project objectives. Project Research Scientist-II. Non-Medical Undertake primary and secondary research, including literature reviews, secondary data analysis, and systematic organization and documentation of research materials. Conduct systematic literature reviews and meta-analyses, and assist in designing and implementing experimental paradigms. Coordinate and support data collection and field research activities, including fieldwork planning, logistics, and liaison with relevant stakeholders. Assist in questionnaire development, data transcription, compilation, entry, coding, and quantitative and qualitative data analysis. Support the preparation of research outputs, including manuscripts for academic journals, research reports, policy briefs, presentations, and other documentation. Maintain research records, project documentation, and data in an organized and systematic manner. Coordinate project-related logistics and facilitate communication among team members and external stakeholders. Undertake other research-related responsibilities assigned by the Project Team. Project Technical Support-I Assist in primary and secondary research activities, including literature reviews, secondary data analysis, and documentation of research materials. Coordinate and support data collection and field research activities, including fieldwork logistics and stakeholder liaison. Assist in questionnaire development, data transcription, compilation, entry, coding, and data analysis. Support the preparation of research presentations, reports, and other project-related documents. Assist with project implementation, including coordination, logistics, record-keeping, and documentation. Undertake other research-related tasks assigned by the Project Team. Project Technical Support-II Undertake and support primary and secondary research activities, including literature reviews and secondary data analysis. Coordinate and support data collection and field research activities, including fieldwork planning, logistics, and stakeholder liaison. Assist in questionnaire development, data transcription, compilation, entry, coding, and data analysis. Support data collection and the preparation of research presentations, reports, and other documentation. Assist with project implementation, including coordination, logistics, record-keeping, and documentation. Undertake other research-related responsibilities assigned by the Project Team.
